simple.summary: שִׁכֻּלִים (shikkulîym) means childlessness (by continued bereavements) First listed occurrence: Isa 49 20.

definitions.usage: to have after loss of others.
definitions.full: H7923. shikkulim [ שִׁכֻּלִים ] noun plural abstract bereavement, childlessness ; — שִׁכֻּלָ֑יִךְ בְּנֵי Isa 49:20 i.e. sons of thee, the bereaved .
